title: Hammock Harbour

services.name: Yurts
services.desc: There are 2 yurts, the Moose and the Maple. They are very similar - both have the same amount of floor space (17' diameter), although the Moose is slightly taller. Both sleep 5 and contain 2 sets of bunk beds - single over single and single over a double futon. They also have a table and chairs. There is a skylight that will open, 3 windows to provide a breeze and a gorgeous view of the lake, private deck, a picnic table, outside water tap, fire pit and outside chairs. There is a handicapped sized private outhouse at the yurts and the main washrooms are 300 meters away. You will need to provide your own pillows and bedding. You may cook on the grill of the fire pit or bring your own cooking

blurb: Hammock Harbour RV Park is a campground on Lake Couchiching with boating, cabin and yurt rentals. Seasonal and transient camping.
